name: sim_checkpoint_roundtrip_seat_states
description: A checkpoint keeps every seat state (design 6.7, M4): four seats in High Water, a caretaker from tick 0, a Lookout who goes AWAY and a Lamplighter who is LEFT, at a busy tick of wave 4 (creeps walking, shots in the air, a creep slowed or marked). A client loaded from the checkpoint gives back the same bytes and the same value in every field of every record (present, caretaker, away, left, and each plan cursor); after BACK, a second at present, caretaker, returning, left. Both loaded clients then follow the turns: the returning seat is handed back at the same tick on every client, the caretakers decide the same, and every hash agrees with the clients that never stopped. The codec stores no new field for M4: the caretaker reads the plan and the board.

steps.until: scene.client(1).creeps.size() >= 5 and scene.client(1).shots.size() >= 2 and scene.effects_on_road()[0] + scene.effects_on_road()[1] > 0

steps.assert: busy_a[1] >= 5 and busy_a[2] >= 2 and busy_a[4][0] + busy_a[4][1] > 0 and scene.client(1).seat(2).plan_cursor > 0
steps.msg: a busy tick: creeps walking, shots in the air, an effect on a creep, the caretakers into their plans
deserialize(serialize()) gives back the same bytes
and every field of every record: each seat's state, Ready, gold and plan cursor
present, caretaker, away and left come back as they were
and later present, caretaker, returning and left, mid-wave
the second checkpoint round-trips too, returning seat and all

steps.assert: moves_1.size() == 3 and moves_1[2][1] == 'present' and scene.since(scene.seat_moves(3, 3), 0).has(moves_1[2]) and scene.seat_moves(3, 4) == [moves_1[2]]
steps.msg: the loaded clients hand the returning seat back at the same tick as the others

steps.assert: scene.hashes_agree() and scene.record_differences(1, 3) == [] and scene.record_differences(1, 4) == [] and scene.record_differences(1, 2) == []
steps.msg: every hash after each load agrees with the clients that never stopped
